strengths: Explicit code-based positive weights preserve linear-order product marginals while exponentially many normalized transfer eigenvalues approach one exponentially fast.
Code symmetry proves the same marginal equality for the actual Perron stationary law, avoiding conflation of weighting and stationary laws.
The exact parity transfer spectrum correctly separates the transfer family from single-site heat-bath dynamics.
The upper-density-only dimension-free gap proof handles zero densities without a hidden lower-density assumption; sign-part compression avoids small-sign-mass loss.
The manuscript clearly excludes fixed-range Gibbs, local-dynamics, continuum and physical mass-gap conclusions.
weaknesses: O1 - Originality not established (substantive positioning issue, not a proof failure). Pages 8-9 provide honest but short comparisons. Before claiming a major original theorem, compare Theorem 7 with quantitative positivity-improving/hyperbounded-operator results and compare Theorem 1 with known code-supported small-noise or transfer constructions. Supply exact hypotheses and conclusions, rather than relying on title-level differences or absence of search hits. The present caveat is adequate for a working paper.

O2 - Quantitative sharpness is largely unexplored (research limitation). At B=1 the density is exactly one and the true gap is 1-rho, while the displayed bound is 2^(-2 e_rho). The deterioration as rho tends to one is particularly severe. Corollary 8 consequently supplies a necessary exponential rate which need not match the construction's rate. Add an explicit elementary benchmark and explain which parameter regimes, if any, make the bound numerically informative. No current theorem is false because of this loss.

O3 - Application relevance remains narrow (research limitation). The examples allow global many-body weights and full-configuration transitions. A concrete application within that class would clarify why retaining both weighting and stationary marginals matters beyond a logical obstruction. Do not use the word Ising in the title as evidence of fixed-range physical relevance; the body already supplies the correct restriction.

O4 - Clarify one sign-part step (minor exposition). On page 7, add a line explaining that lambda_2 h_+<=T_r h_+ holds on the positive support by the eigenrelation and elsewhere by positivity, with the same argument for h_-. Also identify that the final lower bound <f,P_rho f>>=lambda_2 uses integration against the unit h. The proof as printed is valid, but these are its least immediate transitions.

O5 - Reproduction claims should remain qualified (evidence limitation). This review verified object hashes, source existence, text and supplied page images; it did not rebuild the PDF or independently bind raster output to that build. The advertised source package and preregistered analytical checks were not audited here. Publish an exact manifest and a build recipe if reproducibility is used as a public assessment criterion. Do not label this report a successful build reproduction or machine proof.

O6 - Minor presentation density. The abstract is long, and page 7 concentrates the entire new argument into tightly packed formulas. A short paragraph describing the sign-parts/cross-entry strategy would improve accessibility. No clipping, overlapping equations, missing page numbers, or visibly broken references were found in the supplied nine pages.
